tools.name: Ookla Speed Test
tools.detail: Test internet connection speed
tools.description: Measures your internet connection's ping (latency), download speed, and upload speed. It helps users check their broadband performance, diagnose network issues, compare with global averages, and find optimal internet service providers in their area.

tools.name: Internet Speed Test & Guide
tools.detail: Test speed and check internet needs
tools.description: This tool measures your internet connection's download and upload speeds. More than just a basic tester, it provides extensive educational guides to help you understand your results, determine how much speed your household actually needs, troubleshoot slow connections, and find information on internet providers and faster routers.
tags: how much speed do I need

tools.name: Cloudflare Speed Test
tools.detail: Test internet performance and security
tools.description: A performance-focused internet speed test that measures download, upload, latency, and jitter. In addition to basic speed metrics, Cloudflare's test analyzes connection quality and performance, providing detailed insights useful for network troubleshooting and identifying performance bottlenecks. The tool is integrated with Cloudflare's broader suite of network and security services.

tools.name: AT&T Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Test device and gateway internet speed
tools.description: An official internet speed test tool from AT&T for its customers. It allows users to check the upload and download speeds of individual devices (over cellular, wired, or Wi-Fi connections) and separately test the speed of their AT&T All-Fi Hub® or Wi-Fi Gateway equipment to the network. The tool is integrated with support resources to help troubleshoot issues and find suitable AT&T Fiber or AT&T Internet Air® plans.

tools.name: Speakeasy Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Test broadband speed and compare
tools.description: A long-running, classic broadband speed test tool that measures your internet connection's download and upload speeds. Known for its simple interface and reliability, it provides quick results to help users verify their connection performance, compare speeds with advertised plans, and check for basic network issues.

tools.name: CenturyLink Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Test internet speed for troubleshooting
tools.description: An official internet speed test tool for CenturyLink customers to check their broadband connection performance. This tool helps users measure download and upload speeds to verify service levels, troubleshoot slow internet issues, and understand their connection quality. The page is integrated into CenturyLink's help and support system, providing a direct resource for customer diagnostics.

tools.name: Test My Speed
tools.detail: Run internet speed test instantly
tools.description: A straightforward internet speed test tool that measures your connection's download speed, upload speed, and ping in under a minute. The website also provides extensive educational resources, including a guide to help you determine what internet speed tier you need (from under 50 Mbps to over 200+ Mbps) based on your household's activities, as well as FAQs covering ISP throttling, troubleshooting slow internet, and tips to improve Wi-Fi speed.

tools.name: South Africa Speed Test
tools.detail: Test internet speed in South Africa
tools.description: A regional internet speed test platform specifically focused on South Africa. The tool measures the download and upload speeds of your internet connection. It is designed to help users within South Africa test their local broadband performance, compare results, and check their connection against providers and regional averages. The interface is available in multiple languages.

tools.name: Broadband Speed Checker UK
tools.detail: Check UK broadband speed and compare
tools.description: A comprehensive internet speed testing service for the United Kingdom. It allows users to test their broadband download and upload speeds while providing extensive tools to compare results against other users in their local area and postal code. The platform offers detailed insights into UK internet providers, helps find the best broadband deals, and provides guidance on troubleshooting slow connections specific to the UK market.

tools.name: Verizon Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Official Verizon speed test tool
tools.description: The official internet speed test tool from Verizon for its internet customers. This tool is designed to help users measure the download and upload speeds of their Verizon Fios Home Internet or 5G Home Internet connection directly from the provider's network. It assists in troubleshooting performance issues, verifying service levels, and ensuring customers are getting the speeds they pay for from their Verizon plan.

tools.name: BroadbandNow Speed Test
tools.detail: Check broadband speed and compare plans
tools.description: A comprehensive free internet speed test tool that measures download speed, upload speed, and latency (ping). Beyond basic testing, it provides an extensive educational guide to help users understand their results, interpret speed tiers (from <10 Mbps to 1 Gbps+), and determine if their connection is sufficient for activities like remote work or streaming. The tool is integrated with BroadbandNow's core service of helping users find and compare internet service providers (ISPs) and plans available in their specific ZIP code.

tools.name: SpeedSmart Speed Test
tools.detail: HTML5 internet speed test for any device
tools.description: A versatile, HTML5-based internet speed test tool that works accurately across all devices, from desktops and laptops to phones and tablets. It measures ping, jitter, download, and upload speeds to assess connection performance. A key feature is the detailed result history, allowing users to track their connection's performance over time and across multiple devices. The test's accuracy is supported by a global network of 100+ dedicated servers.

tools.name: TestMy.net Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Test upload and download speed separately
tools.description: An independent internet speed test service that allows users to run separate tests for download and upload speeds, as well as an automatic combined test. It provides detailed, granular results including historical data charts to track connection performance over time. The service is known for its transparency and independence from internet service providers (ISPs).

tools.name: PC Matic Speed Test
tools.detail: Test speed with integrated VPN info
tools.description: An internet speed test tool that checks download/upload speeds, latency (ping), and network jitter. A distinctive feature is its integration with PC Matic's VPN service; the test page displays whether the user's VPN is active, shows their protected IP address, ISP, and location. It includes an extensive internet and network glossary to educate users on terms like bandwidth, DHCP, DNS, and traceroute, along with detailed guidance on interpreting results and understanding factors that affect connection speeds.

tools.name: Fusion Connect Speed Test Plus
tools.detail: Business internet speed and quality test
tools.description: A professional-grade internet speed and quality testing tool designed for businesses. Beyond standard download/upload speed measurement, it provides a unique 'Connection & Line Quality Score' by analyzing latency and jitter—critical metrics for VoIP, video conferencing, and real-time applications. The tool saves detailed test history for tracking performance, includes an extensive troubleshooting guide, and is directly integrated with Fusion Connect's suite of business internet, managed WiFi, and SD-WAN optimization services.

tools.name: Xfinity Speed Test
tools.detail: Official test for Xfinity internet customers
tools.description: The official internet speed test tool for Xfinity customers. It measures the speed from Xfinity's servers to the user's specific device (computer, phone, etc.). The tool emphasizes that results often differ from the advertised plan speed due to factors within the home, such as WiFi conditions, device capabilities, and gateway (modem/router) age. It includes extensive educational content explaining the difference between 'plan speed' and 'device speed,' how coverage, gateways, and other devices impact performance, and provides a guide for how much speed common online activities require.

tools.name: Speedtest India
tools.detail: Internet speed test for India
tools.description: A regional internet speed testing website specifically for users in India. The tool measures the download and upload speeds of your internet connection, helping users check their broadband performance against local service providers. It is designed to provide accurate results for the Indian internet infrastructure and is available in multiple languages including Hindi and English.

tools.name: SpeedGeo Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Test and compare internet speeds globally
tools.description: An internet speed test tool with a strong focus on geographic comparison. It measures your download and upload speeds, as well as ping, and then allows you to compare your results directly with the average speeds of other users in your local area, capital region, or any selected region worldwide. The service provides separate result comparisons for both broadband and mobile internet providers, enabling users to see if their connection is performing as expected relative to their neighbors and location.

tools.name: Virgin Media Broadband Speed Test
tools.detail: Official speed test for Virgin Media UK
tools.description: The official broadband speed test for Virgin Media customers in the United Kingdom. This tool allows users to check the performance of their Virgin Media internet connection. It is designed to help customers verify their service, troubleshoot potential issues, and understand the speed they are receiving. As a provider-specific tool, it is integrated into Virgin Media's customer support and broadband service ecosystem.

tools.name: Speedcheck Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Test internet speed and WiFi performance
tools.description: A comprehensive internet speed test tool that measures download speed, upload speed, and ping (latency). The service provides detailed technical explanations of how each test is performed and what the metrics mean. It places a strong emphasis on diagnosing WiFi performance issues, guiding users on how to test connectivity in different locations to determine if problems stem from the ISP, router placement, or device limitations. It recommends using their dedicated mobile apps for the most accurate results on phones and tablets.

tools.name: Telstra Speed Test
tools.detail: Official internet speed test for Telstra
tools.description: The official internet speed test tool for Telstra, Australia's largest telecommunications provider. This tool is designed for Telstra customers to check the performance of their broadband or mobile internet connection. It helps users measure download and upload speeds, assisting in troubleshooting connection issues and verifying service performance against their plan.

tools.name: Chorus NZ Broadband Speed Test
tools.detail: Official broadband speed test for New Zealand
tools.description: The official broadband speed test tool provided by Chorus, New Zealand's largest telecommunications infrastructure company. This tool is designed to help internet users across New Zealand check the performance of their broadband connection by measuring download and upload speeds. As it is provided by the company that manages much of the country's broadband network, it serves as a key diagnostic resource for both consumers and retail service providers (RSPs) to understand connection quality and troubleshoot issues on the Chorus network.

tools.name: METER.net Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Fast and detailed speed analysis
tools.description: A comprehensive internet speed test that measures download, upload, ping, and jitter in about 30 seconds. The tool provides very detailed results, including theoretical data transfer amounts (e.g., how long it would take to download an MP3 or DVD) and comparisons to world averages. The website also features extensive educational articles on networking topics like Li-Fi, 6G, Wi-Fi 7, DNS, and fiber optics. It offers a web plugin service for website owners to embed the test on their own sites.

tools.name: OpenSpeedTest
tools.detail: Open source HTML5 speed test
tools.description: A lightweight, pure HTML5 internet speed test that runs directly in your web browser without requiring Flash, Java, or any plugins. The test measures download speed, upload speed, ping, and jitter. Being open-source, it emphasizes transparency and can be self-hosted on private networks for internal testing. The minimalist design ensures it works quickly and efficiently across all modern devices and browsers.

tools.name: Brightspeed Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Official speed test for Brightspeed customers
tools.description: The official internet speed test for Brightspeed customers to check the performance of their broadband connection. This tool is designed to help users measure download and upload speeds, aiding in troubleshooting connection issues and verifying if they are receiving the expected service levels from their Brightspeed internet plan. It is integrated into the provider's customer support and help resources.

tools.name: M-Lab Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: Open source, research-focused network test
tools.description: An open-source, non-commercial internet speed test provided by Measurement Lab (M-Lab), a consortium dedicated to advancing network research. This tool measures download and upload speeds, as well as latency, with a focus on providing data for public interest research on internet performance and transparency. All test results are made publicly available to help researchers, policymakers, and the public understand the health of the internet.

tools.name: SpeedOf.Me Internet Speed Test
tools.detail: HTML5 browser-based speed test
tools.description: A lightweight, browser-based internet speed test that uses pure HTML5 and JavaScript, requiring no Flash or plugins. It visually measures download and upload speeds in real-time with a live graph that shows speed fluctuations throughout the test. The tool is known for its simplicity, clean interface, and efficiency, working across modern browsers and mobile devices to provide quick connection performance feedback.

tools.name: Quantum Fiber Speed Test

tools.description: The official internet speed test tool for Quantum Fiber customers. This tool is designed to help users of Quantum Fiber's gigabit fiber internet service check the performance of their high-speed connection by measuring download and upload speeds. It assists in troubleshooting and verifying that the ultra-fast, symmetrical speeds characteristic of fiber-optic service are being delivered as expected.

tools.name: CESNET Speed Test

It measures connection performance to support high-bandwidth scientific data transfers, collaboration, and network research, rather than general consumer broadband diagnostics.
